rows.en: Hah, hah... Sorry...
Her skills at what, I wonder...
No! You were nothing like that!
rows.notes: Female only; answers 'I can't move like I used to'.

rows.en: Sensei, who is 'that one'?
rows.notes: Female only; quotes Hilda's 'aitsu', kept neutral as in slice 79 (c05920/c05921).

rows.en: Ah, I'm still worn out from before...
(Sensei seemed a little off somehow...)

(Off to the artificial island with Hilda-sensei
again today!)

Heh, good, then.
So, without further ado... let's go kick back!
rows.notes: Hilda; 'hane wo nobasu' (stretch one's wings) = relax.

rows.en: Sloppy as ever, aren't you...
No... you're just way too amazing, Hilda-sensei...

If you're aiming to be a pilot too, you need
to move at least this well, or you're nowhere...
Yes! I'll keep working at it!
Mm, good. Then let's head home.
(That was another fun day!)

(To the artificial island with Hilda-sensei
again today!)

No... it's just that you're way too amazing,
Hilda-sensei...
Yeees, I'll keep working at it!
(That was another fun day!)

(Today Sensei's the one who set the meeting time.
I wonder what's going on...)
\p, sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Hilda, in an unusually soft tone (-ne ending).

rows.en: No, not that long...
(Sensei's vibe seems different today...)
You've been working really hard.
Sensei, where's this coming from all of a sudden?

No... I've watched you for nearly two years now,
and I think you've really done well.
No, that's because you properly...
rows.notes: Both genders; cut off by Hilda.

rows.en:
I'm only teaching you what you need.
That's only natural for a teacher.

I want to teach motivated students properly.
I want them to become proper students...
no, proper adults.

But, you know...
There are other teachers, yet you came to me.
You're an odd one, aren't you...

I may be a woman, but I'm hardly charming,
and I'm not kind either. So why did you
come to someone like me?
That's not...

No, it's fine.
I enjoyed the training and the unwinding too.
It let me forget about the past for a while...
Sensei... that 'that one' you always mention...

Ah, well, that's in the past. A real idiot,
but the one I remember most of all.
No... maybe precisely because of that...
rows.notes: Hilda, male version; 'aitsu' kept gender-neutral (no he/she).

rows.en: Sensei, about that person... do you...
rows.notes: Both genders; trails off (asking whether she has feelings for them).

rows.en:
Don't be stupid. That's over and done with.
Besides, that one is...
...Don't tell me that person is already...
rows.notes: Both genders; implies 'dead', trailing as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Ngh...
rows.notes: Hilda (stifling laughter, read as grief by the player).

rows.en: Heh-heh-heh...
Um...
Hah, hah... Ah, sorry about that.

I just cracked up a little.
No, they're alive. Alive and kicking.
That one wouldn't die even if you killed them.
Oh, is that so? That's kind of a relief.
Hm, what's with you?

No, it's just... you can never beat someone
who's passed away...
rows.notes: Male only; he is relieved he is not competing with a dead rival.

rows.en: What's that supposed to mean?
No, it's... um...

Well, never mind that.
What I'm trying to say is,
'Give everything your all.'
Yes, I've got that down already!

Mm, good.
Then shall we go get a Super Chili-Chili Dog?
rows.notes: Hilda, male version; the scorching hot dog from frd_hld_006. 'Super Chili-Chili Dog' not in the glossary (also frd_kln_002).

rows.en: Uh, please spare me that...
(Sensei must have been through a lot too...)
Sensei, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?
That's not true! You've got...
rows.notes: Female only; cut off by Hilda.

rows.en:
Ah, well, that's in the past. A real idiot,
but the one I remember most of all.
No... maybe precisely because of that.

Oh, is that so?
Geez, don't scare me like that!
Heh, sorry.
Yes! I've got that down already!

Mm, good.
Then shall we go get a Super Chili-Chili Dog?
Huh? Um... that's a bit...
(Sensei must have been through a lot too...)
(Hilda-sensei called me out again, but...)
Hey, you're late...
Ah, sorry...

No, it's no problem.
Well, have a seat there.

It's nice to talk with a student like this
once in a while.
Oh, is that so?

Yeah. Normally I keep my guard up as a teacher,
so I can't help being strict...
I... guess so...

Talking with you isn't bad either.
If we get another chance, I'm counting on you.
(I got to see a different side of Hilda-sensei...)
(Hilda-sensei called me out again, but...)
(Maybe I got to see a different side of Hilda-sensei...)

uncertain: c05944/c05973/c05974/c05982/c05995: Hilda's past partner 'aitsu' stays unidentified and genderless (as in slice 79): 'that one', 'they'. If the game or the glossary identifies this person later, these rows (and slice 79 c05920/c05921/c05929) should switch to he/she.
missing_glossary: Super Chili-Chili Dog (supa chirichiri doggu), the very spicy hot dog of the Hilda scenes, also in frd_kln_002 (c07781): rendered 'Super Chili-Chili Dog' in c05990/c05999.
